facts: Skin generated interactively as torso deforms and limbs attach/detach; blobby implicit surface/metaballs selected.
Developer names ear clipping for tessellation and Moore/Warren mesh displacement to reduce thin triangles; this section does not establish marching tetrahedra or BCC lattice.
Single global implicit surface without metaball groups can connect neighboring limbs into webbing; no universal anti-merging guarantee.
Only spherical metaballs distributed along torso and limbs; exact spacing formula not provided.
Vertex bone weights derived from body-part provenance of metaballs; exact kernel, smoothing and influence cap not provided.
Fat torso spine segments may produce uneven weights and shearing; attached-part correction unresolved in developer account.
Anatomical detail parts are authored deformable Maya Rigblocks.
limits: Historical developer account not aligned to local executable functions.
Algorithm constants and mapping to local version unknown.
